messages:
Alex (PM): quick sync — Q3 console/observability roadmap. need to pick final scope for dashboards, tracing UX, error analysis, and retention tiers. customer asks are piling up, and we need launch criteria for beta.
Mira (Eng): agree. main constraint is storage + query perf for long retention. we can do 90d cold storage + 7d hot, but cost hit if everyone enables hot.
Sam (SRE): +1. we should define SLOs per retention tier. 99.9% query availability for hot, best-effort for cold. also need retention-ttl enforcement in ingest path.
Jordan (Product): customers asking for per-route cost breakdowns in the dashboard and an alerting hook for regressions. can we ship minimal version and iterate?
Lee (DevEx): minimal UX: default dashboard with ingress, p95 latency, error-rate, cost burn. advanced: custom widgets, saved queries. default should be opinionated.
Mira (Eng): re: tracing — we should prioritize span sampling controls + tail-based sampling for high-card services. full traces everywhere will explode storage.
Sam (SRE): propose: sampling config + adaptive tail sampling policy. add a backpressure signal to avoid OOMs.
Alex (PM): good. we need explicit launch criteria. draft: (1) dashboard basic metrics wired for top 5 customer apps, (2) tracing + sampling controls enabled, (3) error analysis UI with root-cause drilldown, (4) retention policy UI with clear cost estimates, (5) docs + migration guide. thoughts?
Jordan (Product): add: experiment plan for canary with 3 pilot customers and rollback plan. also success metric: reduce time-to-detect by 30% for pilots.
Lee (DevEx): UX acceptance: onboarding flow < 10 min for pilots, and a guided tour. also need telemetry for feature usage.
Mira (Eng): dev notes — rough config for retention API we can expose:
```
POST /v1/observability/retention
{
  "dataset": "console-logs",
  "tier": "hot|cold",
  "duration_days": 7,
  "discard_after_days": 90
}
```
Important: enforce quota per org.
Sam (SRE): also require export path for cold tier (S3-compatible) and retention-billing hook.
Alex (PM): scope negotiation: if we can't get hot for all customers at GA, we gate hot behind Dedicated + Enterprise. GA includes cold + limited hot for pilots. ok?
Jordan (Product): ok, call that 'GA (pilot hot) + Enterprise hot expansion'. document in launch plan.
Lee (DevEx): timeline ask: can we get a feature-flagged beta in 8 weeks? we'll need mocks + sample datasets for docs.
Mira (Eng): engineering estimate: 8-10 weeks for core + sampling + retention enforcement if no major infra blockers. 12+ if we add custom widgets before beta.
Alex (PM): decision: ship beta without custom widgets. prioritize sampling + retention + core dashboards. action items: Mira — infra/estimate + spike on tail-sampling (due in 1w). Sam — retention SLOs + export design (due in 1w). Lee — beta mocks + onboarding flow (due in 2w). Jordan — pilot list + outreach (due in 2w). I'll update roadmap and OKRs doc.
